## Summary

Describe the user outcome and smallest safe change.

## Trust-boundary impact

- Protected data class or leak path:
- Inputs, outputs, storage, logs, and network paths affected:
- Failure mode and rollback:

## Validation

- [ ] Synthetic fixtures only
- [ ] Narrow tests and full `pytest`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] Python compilation
- [ ] Deterministic frontend review, if UI changed
- [ ] Documentation matches supported behavior and limitations
- [ ] No raw payloads, credentials, private data, or unverified weights committed
- [ ] Proxy forwarding remains disabled unless separately reviewed and approved
